questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?
questions.rationale: The requested single-file, no-dependency HTML app is best implemented with vanilla JavaScript.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Vanilla JavaScript in the single HTML file.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript requiring a build step.

questions.question: Which frontend framework or approach should be used?
questions.rationale: The brief explicitly requires one index.html file with no dependencies or server.

options.label: Plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
options.description: A self-contained static page with no framework or build step.

options.label: React
options.description: A component-based frontend that requires dependencies and a build step.

questions.question: What frontend features should be included?
questions.answer: 10-question space exploration quiz; accessible colorful interface; progress bar; score counter; animated right/wrong feedback; results screen; single index.html with no server or dependencies.
questions.rationale: These requirements are explicitly stated in the brief.
questions.recommendedChoice: 10-question space exploration quiz; accessible colorful interface; progress bar; score counter; animated right/wrong feedback; results screen; single index.html with no server or dependencies.

questions.question: Which data stores does the app need?
questions.rationale: The quiz is a static client-side page and does not require persistence, file storage, a queue, or a cache.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Keep all quiz state in the browser for the current session.

options.label: Azure Blob Storage
options.description: Store and serve files or media.

questions.question: Do users need to sign in for application features?
questions.rationale: The brief describes a public static quiz with no account-based features.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users sign in to use application features.

options.label: No
options.description: The application is available without user sign-in.
